noticeTypes.title: Notice board(s) to scrape
noticeTypes.description: Which PPDA notice board(s) to fetch. Each is a separate page on ppda.mw with its own table.

keyword.title: Filter by keyword
keyword.description: Only return notices whose title, institution, or reference number contains this text (case-insensitive). Leave blank to return every notice currently on the selected board(s).

keywords.title: Filter by multiple keywords
keywords.description: Run multiple keyword filters in one job (each produces its own tagged set of matching records). Combined with 'keyword' if both are set.

onlyOpenTenders.title: Only open (not yet closed) tenders
onlyOpenTenders.description: If true, excludes 'tenders' board rows whose Closing Date has already passed. Has no effect on the other notice boards (awards, intentions, debarments, admin_reviews don't have a closing date).

maxResults.title: Max results per notice board per keyword
maxResults.description: Caps how many notice records are pushed to the dataset per notice board per keyword (or overall, if no keyword is given). Each board is a single page (tens to low hundreds of rows), so this mostly exists as a safety cap.
